name: WITHIN (Daddy Visual Novel)
source:
Set in the quiet city of Haven, where appearances matter more than truth, hidden desires are forced to remain buried beneath fear, shame, and silence. The protagonist lives with his aunt, trying to survive a life shaped by expectations and secrets in a town where anything related to being gay is treated as something forbidden — something that must never be exposed to the public. But behind Haven’s ordinary streets lies a hidden world filled with longing, temptation, and men carrying secrets of their own.

As he struggles between repression and acceptance, he will encounter a cast of dominant daddies, bears, and irresistibly beefy men — each capable of changing his life in different ways. Some relationships may offer comfort. Others may awaken desires he spent years trying to suppress.

Every choice tests whether he will accept who he truly is… or continue hiding behind the life others expect from him.

[From [url=https://xandivara.itch.io/within]itch.io[/url]]
